mapper.select: SELECT A.create_user as launchUser, A.finprod_id AS portfolioId, NVL(a.FINPROD_ABBR,a.FINPROD_name) portfolioName, '' AS nextUser FROM FIN_PRODUCT A inner join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD C on A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID where A.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16' AND A.PROFIT_TYPE = '02' and C.ISSUE_STATUS IN ('01','03') and a.mdate <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT DEAL.FINPROD_ID FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL DEAL WHERE DEAL.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID AND DEAL.PS IN ('C20','C5') AND DEAL.IS_CANCEL = 'N' and deal.trade_status = '01' )

SELECT A.create_user as launchUser, A.finprod_id AS portfolioId, NVL(a.FINPROD_ABBR,a.FINPROD_name) portfolioName, '' AS nextUser FROM FIN_PRODUCT A inner join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD C on A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID left join ( select fci.finprod_id, max(e_accr_date) eaccrdate from fin_float_counting_rule ffcr inner join fin_cash_info fci on ffcr.cash_id = fci.cash_id and fci.cash_type_1 = '03' group by fci.finprod_id ) maxdate on A.FINPROD_ID = maxdate.FINPROD_ID where A.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16' AND A.PROFIT_TYPE in ('01','03') and C.ISSUE_STATUS IN ('01','03') and nvl(maxdate.eaccrdate,a.mdate) <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT DEAL.FINPROD_ID FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL DEAL WHERE DEAL.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID AND DEAL.PS IN ('C20','C5') AND DEAL.IS_CANCEL = 'N' and deal.trade_status = '01' )
